name: primitives-headless-dialog
blurb: Dialog flips in from a direction with 3D perspective and blur.
description: Headless UI dialog wrapped with Framer Motion that animates panel entrance with 3D perspective rotation. Direction configurable (top/bottom/left/right). Backdrop fades with blur. Composed header, title, description, and footer.
use_when: You want a polished modal with directional entrance animations that feel dimensional.
avoid_when: Older browsers or performance-sensitive contexts — 3D perspective has render costs.
a11y: Built on Headless UI primitives with full keyboard support (Escape closes). Render prop pattern on DialogPanel for advanced composition.
